text: The recipe copies existing values and individual .accesskey, .title and .placeholder patterns from Account Setup into Account Hub IDs. It uses target = reference for this one output path and preserves the source brand term. Exact attribute casing matters to the static references. This is a scoped migration example, not a global naming rule or proof that the migration ran for every locale.
title: The Account Hub recipe copies values and attributes through one target path
